strings.zh: 喔哦！！{NEWLINE}你终于来了呢！{SCROLL}欢迎来到口袋妖怪的世界！{SCROLL}我的名字是七度灶！{NEWLINE}大家都叫我精灵博士。{SCROLL}话说回来,你是{NEWLINE}第一次参加冒险么？{SCROLL}可以的话,由我来{NEWLINE}为你介绍一下把！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Well, hello!{NEWLINE}You’re finally here!{SCROLL}Welcome to the world of Pokémon!{SCROLL}My name is Rowan.{NEWLINE}People call me the Pokémon Professor.{SCROLL}By the way, is this your{NEWLINE}first adventure?{SCROLL}If you like, let me tell you{NEWLINE}a little about it!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 游戏中会用到很多不同的按键,{NEWLINE}由我来依次说明一下。
strings.en: You’ll use many different buttons{NEWLINE}in the game. Let me explain them.

strings.en: Use the +Control Pad to move{NEWLINE}the main character. It’s also{NEWLINE}used to choose options.{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}Used to confirm, check things{NEWLINE}and talk to people.{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}Use this to go back or cancel.

strings.zh: 想要打开菜单时,{NEWLINE}使用这个按键。{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}替换道具或登陆重要的{NEWLINE}物品的时候使用。{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}对于玩法、操作方法有疑问,{NEWLINE}碰到麻烦的时候,{NEWLINE}请按Ｌ键或Ｒ键。
strings.en: Press this button to{NEWLINE}open the menu.{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}Used to swap items or{NEWLINE}register Key Items.{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}If you have questions about{NEWLINE}how to play or get stuck,{NEWLINE}press the L or R Button.

strings.zh: 下面的画面{NEWLINE}叫做“触摸屏”。{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}在触摸屏上,{NEWLINE}根据情况的不同,{NEWLINE}会显示出各种各样的按钮。{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}请自己试着触摸看看。
strings.en: The lower screen is called{NEWLINE}the “Touch Screen.”{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}Different buttons appear on{NEWLINE}the Touch Screen depending{NEWLINE}on the situation.{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}Try touching it yourself.

strings.zh: 在从今以后开始的世界中,{NEWLINE}你就要作为主人公,{NEWLINE}展开一个人的冒险了。
strings.en: You are about to enter a world{NEWLINE}where you will embark on an{NEWLINE}adventure all your own.

strings.zh: 与在城里、路上、洞窟内、{NEWLINE}屋子里等各个地方的人说话,{NEWLINE}调查各种各样的物品,{NEWLINE}搜集提示和情报吧。
strings.en: Talk to people in towns, on roads,{NEWLINE}in caves, in houses and more.{NEWLINE}Check all kinds of things, and{NEWLINE}gather hints and information.

strings.zh: 然后,帮助有难处的人们,{NEWLINE}通过解开谜题,{NEWLINE}进而开启新的道路。{NEWLINE}请一步一步向着目标迈进！
strings.en: Help people in need and solve{NEWLINE}mysteries to open new paths.{NEWLINE}Keep moving toward your goal,{NEWLINE}one step at a time!

strings.zh: 有时,被邀请进行对战,{NEWLINE}与野生的生物们{NEWLINE}战斗的情况也是有的哟。
strings.en: At times, you’ll be challenged{NEWLINE}to battles, or you may have to{NEWLINE}fight wild creatures.

strings.zh: 通过冒险,{NEWLINE}在与各种各样的人交流中,{NEWLINE}逐渐成长起来。
strings.en: On your adventure, you’ll grow{NEWLINE}by meeting and getting to know{NEWLINE}all kinds of people.

strings.zh: 这正是此次冒险{NEWLINE}最主要的目标所在。{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}　　按Ａ键返回。
strings.en: That is the most important{NEWLINE}goal of this adventure.{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}Press the A Button to go back.

strings.zh: 在这个世界上,{NEWLINE}到处生活着{SCROLL}口袋妖怪{NEWLINE}又名：「精灵」{CLEAR}这种不可思议的生物！{SCROLL}我们人类{NEWLINE}和精灵友好融洽地生活在一起。{SCROLL}一起玩耍,{NEWLINE}协力工作,{SCROLL}在与精灵同伴合作的对战中,{NEWLINE}建立起深刻的羁绊⋯⋯{SCROLL}而我呢,{NEWLINE}对于这样的精灵们的情况{CLEAR}想知道得越详细越好,{CLEAR}所以正致力于这方面的研究。{SCROLL}那么首先,{NEWLINE}请告诉我一些你的事情吧！{SCROLL}你是男生吧？{NEWLINE}还是女生呢？
strings.en: This world is widely inhabited{NEWLINE}by creatures{SCROLL}called Pocket Monsters,{NEWLINE}or Pokémon for short:{CLEAR}truly mysterious creatures!{SCROLL}We humans live alongside Pokémon{NEWLINE}as friends.{SCROLL}We play together,{NEWLINE}and we work together.{SCROLL}When we battle alongside Pokémon,{NEWLINE}we form deep bonds with them...{SCROLL}As for me,{NEWLINE}I want to learn as much as I can{CLEAR}about Pokémon,{CLEAR}so that’s what I research.{SCROLL}Now then, first,{NEWLINE}tell me a little about yourself!{SCROLL}Are you a boy?{NEWLINE}Or are you a girl?
